tpl_prayer: Please pray for our country during this season of national leadership transition. Pray for peace, unity, across our nation and for leaders who will serve with integrity a heart for others.
tpl_praise: We praise God for his faithful guidance during recent leadership transitions at Compassion Bangladesh. Changes were carried out smoothly and with wisdom, and his guidance and provision were evident throughout.
tpl_looking_forward: We look forward to strengthening how we serve children by improving the way we plan and manage resources, including new tools to guide planning and support financial management. This will help local partners to serve with excellence and help us reach more children more quickly with greater impact.

tpl_prayer: Please pray for the restoration of lasting peace in our country. Many families have been displaced by conflict, and we long to see them return home to rebuild their lives and communities with hope and security.
tpl_praise: Praise God for strengthening our relationship with the government this year. This partnership has opened doors for greater collaboration and helped us serve more effectively, bringing encouragement to our team and the communities we support.
tpl_looking_forward: In the coming year, we look forward to seeing peace established across the land and more young people succeed in their studies and careers, grow in their health and come to know Christ personally. We believe these opportunities will empower them to build a sustainable future, contribute positively to society and become agents of transformation in their communities.

tpl_prayer: We have a new president serving from November 2025 through 2030. As our country navigates a challenging economic situation, please join us in praying for our leaders — that they will be guided by the Holy Spirit with wisdom, compassion and a heart for those in need.
tpl_praise: The staff in Bolivia have shown remarkable commitment to Compassion’s ministry. Even as their families faced similar challenges, they continued to serve faithfully. We thank God for their dedication and lift up their families in prayer.
tpl_looking_forward: Global Compassion leaders are committed to strengthening how we serve children to help release them from poverty in Jesus’ name. Please pray for Compassion Bolivia to guide local churches to support children in ways that fit their unique context.

tpl_prayer: Please pray for our new expansion area deep in the Amazon. Reaching these communities often requires long journeys by boat, small plane or canoe. This will be our new adventure to serve even more vulnerable kids in this remote region of Brazil.
tpl_praise: We praise the Lord for all the amazing work that Compassion's church partners have been doing and for the thousands of kids impacted by the program and child protection initiatives.
tpl_looking_forward: We look forward to seeing how Compassion will impact vulnerable children living in forgotten places across our vast country, such as the Amazon jungle.

tpl_prayer: The most vulnerable communities in our country are often those most affected by violence. Please pray that the local church can continue to reach children and families in remote and underserved areas of Colombia despite increasing violence. Pray also that more young people will finish school and go on to higher education so they are not drawn into recruitment by armed groups.
tpl_praise: Praise God for his wisdom and power, which enabled us to carry out a wide-reaching effort to better understand the needs of children and youths. This new approach is helping churches connect more deeply with children and respond more effectively as they support them in overcoming poverty in Jesus' name.
tpl_looking_forward: We plan to reach more children living in poverty in remote areas such as Chocó, Tumaco and La Guajira — including Afro-descendant and Indigenous communities — by partnering with local churches already serving these areas.

tpl_prayer: Pray that God will guide us to find creative ways to support Christians who want to serve children living in poverty in the Dominican Republic, equipping them with the resources they need — training, tools, partnerships and funding — to disciple children in every area of life.
tpl_praise: We thank the Lord for allowing us to celebrate 55 years of serving children and families living in poverty in the Dominican Republic.
tpl_looking_forward: We look forward to supporting children's ministry in 50 churches in communities without sponsorship support. This will include providing materials for Sunday school, training for church leaders and creative ways to involve parents in their children's development.

tpl_prayer: Please pray that we may continue to bring hope, joy, peace and life to the children and youths we serve alongside the local church. May everything we do reflect his love and expand his kingdom among the most vulnerable, shining a light in every community we serve.
tpl_praise: Throughout this year, we have witnessed God's guidance, care, provision and unfailing love. Despite the many challenges our country has faced, God has faithfully protected the children and youths in our programs. We have seen him in every circumstance — from the daily welcome of each child embraced with love to the miracles in the lives of the most vulnerable.
tpl_looking_forward: We pray that God will help us remain faithful to the calling he has given us and keep him at the center of all we do. May he continue to use us to bring hope and release children from poverty in Jesus’ name.

tpl_prayer: Let's pray that God provides protection and provision for communities facing food insecurity and opens the way for children and youths in El Salvador to access education, nutrition and new opportunities.
tpl_praise: Praise God that Compassion is equipping our local church partners with new ways to better understand the needs of the children in their care — listening through regular surveys to see where help is needed most and responding with proven initiatives that will make the greatest impact. This empowers us to break the cycle of poverty and despair in young people's lives.
tpl_looking_forward: In the coming year, we look forward to working more closely with Christ-centered denominational leaders, mobilizing the Church toward Bible-based discipleship.

tpl_prayer: Concerns around security in some areas of the country are affecting people’s movement and daily life. Please pray for peace to prevail throughout the nation — from north to south, from east to west, and from central areas to remote communities.
tpl_praise: Praise God for the unwavering commitment of Ethiopian churches to serve children, families and vulnerable people in every season.
tpl_looking_forward: We long to see a growing movement of local churches sponsoring children in poverty with the resources they have, however small. Please pray for a fresh movement of the Holy Spirit to guide, lead and empower Compassion Ethiopia and the local churches in this work.

tpl_prayer: Please pray for wisdom and excellence in all we do. May God guide us to steward resources faithfully, strengthen partnerships, and ensure that every child encounters the love of Christ in a tangible and life-changing way.
tpl_praise: We celebrate God’s goodness for a memorable and successful commemoration of 20 years of Compassion’s ministry in Ghana. We rejoice in the remarkable progress we see in the lives of those we serve. Children and youths are growing in their faith, excelling in their studies and experiencing improved health. Caregivers are gaining strength, dignity and renewed purpose. Each testimony is a powerful witness to God’s provision and grace at work.
tpl_looking_forward: With God’s help and your continued partnership, we aim to reach more vulnerable communities and deepen our impact in caring for children. We believe the year ahead will bring greater transformation, renewed hope and lasting change for many more children and families.

tpl_prayer: Please join us in praying for God’s guidance and favor as this church-led movement grows and expands. Our desire is for all children living in vulnerable circumstances in Guatemala to be supported to grow and experience lasting transformation.
tpl_praise: We celebrate God’s faithfulness this year as we have made meaningful progress that will help our church partners and national office to reach more children and better respond to their needs.
tpl_looking_forward: We are excited to see our church partners taking ownership of the sustainability of their ministries. In the coming year, we look forward to strengthening their capacity and ability to mobilize resources, helping their impact to last for generations.

tpl_prayer: Please pray for peace, stability and renewed hope in Haiti and for God’s continued protection and strength over our staff, church partners and the children and families we serve. May the Lord guide us with wisdom as we navigate ongoing challenges and remain faithful to our mission of releasing children from poverty in Jesus’ name.
tpl_praise: We praise God for his faithfulness throughout a difficult year, as we have seen great resilience among our church partners and meaningful progress in the lives of the children and youths despite many challenges. God has also opened doors for deeper community engagement, strengthened partnerships and provided the resources needed to continue serving the most vulnerable.
tpl_looking_forward: In the coming year, we are committed to strengthening our partnerships with local churches across Haiti. By walking closely with our partners — listening, equipping and supporting them — we will deepen unity and collaboration, extend our reach and see greater transformation of children and youths living in poverty in Haiti.

tpl_prayer: Pray for God's guidance and wisdom for the Compassion Honduras national office as we continue to serve staff, support church partners in their ministries to children and youths, and reach children and families living in poverty.
tpl_praise: We are grateful for the Church in our country, which is willing to step out of its comfort zone to share the message of salvation with those in need. We also thank the Lord for the progress made with an initial group of church partners who are building new capacity to better understand and respond to the needs of children, youths and families in their communities.
tpl_looking_forward: We continue to identify new areas of need and partner with churches to reach the most vulnerable children and support their holistic development.

tpl_prayer: Pray that more youths will have access to higher education or vocational training and that together with parents and Compassion's church partners, we can support them with the resources they need.
tpl_praise: We are establishing new partnerships with local churches in Papua and Toraja, expanding our ministry into tribal areas and reaching some of the most vulnerable communities in east Indonesia.
tpl_looking_forward: We look forward to seeing more children sponsored and more young people finishing the program strong.

tpl_prayer: Pray that more youths will have access to higher education or vocational training and that together with parents and Compassion's church partners, we can support them with the resources they need.
tpl_praise: We are establishing new partnerships with local churches in Papua and Toraja, expanding our ministry into tribal areas and reaching some of the most vulnerable communities in east Indonesia.
tpl_looking_forward: We look forward to seeing more children sponsored and more young people finishing the program strong.

tpl_prayer: Pray for wisdom as we build strategic partnerships with other like-minded ministries and organizations to best support children in need. Pray for young people facing limited job opportunities and the challenges that come with this, including mental health struggles. Pray also for the country’s economic situation to improve and for peaceful elections in 2027.
tpl_praise: I am delighted to share that Compassion International Kenya was named NGO of the Year at Kenya's 2025 NGO Awards. This is a testament to God’s hand on the work we do and an encouragement to continue faithfully serving babies, children, young people and their families.
tpl_looking_forward: In the past two years, we have partnered with academic and technical institutions to provide short-term, market-relevant skills training for youths. So far, more than 1,500 young people have graduated with certified skills, enabling them to earn an income while continuing their studies.

tpl_prayer: May our partnerships lead to lasting transformation in the lives of children and communities.
tpl_praise: We’re grateful for the unwavering commitment of our Compassion Sri Lanka national office team and local partners.
tpl_looking_forward: We look forward to seeing even greater impact as the program grows stronger and children's and young people's lives are transformed.

tpl_prayer: Pray that violence in our country will decrease so that children can safely attend their Compassion centers and the church can provide the care they need. Pray also for Compassion staff to travel safely as they support and train churches to strengthen programs for children.
tpl_praise: Praise God that this year we've been able to introduce a new approach that helps us to listen more closely to children, ensuring their voices are heard as plans are made to support their growth and well-being.
tpl_looking_forward: In the coming year, we look forward to having more financial resources for the sponsorship program and expand into new ways of supporting children and families.

tpl_prayer: Please pray for God's protection over the Church and that it will continue to faithfully carry out its mission. Pray also for the emotional and spiritual well-being of our staff as they navigate a challenging environment. Ask God to guard and guide us, giving wisdom and discernment in every decision, so Compassion Nicaragua can continue to operate under his grace and favor.
tpl_praise: We glorify God for the work of our partner churches as they faithfully minister and care for each child, bringing meaningful impact to their lives. We also praise God for his faithfulness in sustaining Compassion's work in Nicaragua through the teamwork of our staff while maintaining a strong, trusted presence in the country.
tpl_looking_forward: We are encouraged to see so many churches trusting God, embracing his work, and reaching more children and youths in poverty as new churches grow within their communities. It is rewarding to witness the lasting impact, as young people and families use what they have learned to earn an income and serve others in their churches and communities.

tpl_prayer: Pray for the Lord’s care and wisdom over the children, church partners and staff this year as Peru moves forward following the recent elections. Pray for peace across the country and for leaders who will protect and care for children and youths.
tpl_praise: We thank God for the opportunity to work in Indigenous communities, supporting our church partners as they meet the needs of children and youths. We pray that the Lord will help us to be a strong support to these communities.
tpl_looking_forward: We are encouraged to see how our new program framework is helping Compassion and the church partners to better understand children's needs. We want to support our church partners as they respond to those needs and bring meaningful impact to children's lives.

tpl_prayer: Pray for our church partners and the teams supporting them as they manage the new initiatives and responsibilities. Pray also for the well-being of our staff and church volunteers, especially as they respond during times of disaster.
tpl_praise: We are thankful for the graduates of our program who are investing in and discipling the next generation of proactive young leaders. We look forward to continuing to develop initiatives that grow and sustain these efforts.
tpl_looking_forward: We are preparing for expansion into the tribal regions by partnering with churches in Mindanao in the southern Philippines from 2027 onward. Pray that God will grant wisdom, cultural sensitivity and discernment as we partner with Indigenous communities.

tpl_prayer: Pray for our church partners in Rwanda as they work through a national government compliance process required across the country. May the Lord grant them wisdom, guidance and the financial provision needed to meet all regulatory requirements with excellence.
tpl_praise: We are grateful that the planning and monitoring workshops for our new program framework — which uses technology to survey children and discover their greatest needs before responding with proven initiatives — were successful and that our team is now well equipped to support church partners as they better understand and support children's needs.
tpl_looking_forward: We look forward to guiding church partners through our new planning process to identify and respond to children's needs as they develop clear three-year plans to better support children and families.

tpl_prayer: Pray for five children who are suffering from cancer and undergoing chemotherapy; ask God for healing and strength. Pray also for security and stability in the northern region, where families face ongoing threats of violence.
tpl_praise: We praise God for his faithfulness in strengthening our partnerships and expanding transformational initiatives for children and youths. This year, we have seen tangible progress: 1,346 youths earned their “baccalauréat” (final high school diploma), with pass rates significantly higher than the national average.
tpl_looking_forward: We look forward to strengthening how we empower young people, especially by growing programs that prepare them for higher education, STEM careers, entrepreneurship and leadership. We are excited to see more graduates become change makers — sparks of hope in their communities.

tpl_prayer: Please pray for safety and security of the children and youths and for stability along the Thailand-Myanmar border.
tpl_praise: We thank God for his grace and mercy, which allows us to continue reaching more youths and children in need through our partner churches. We also thank our valued supporters for their heart and generosity in joining the ministry.
tpl_looking_forward: We look forward to reaching more children and youths in need and welcoming them into our program to support their growth and development.

tpl_prayer: Please join us in praying for lasting peace in our nation as we continue to navigate post-election tensions. Pray for the Church in Tanzania to be strengthened and united as they advance God's kingdom.
tpl_praise: We are grateful that Compassion International Tanzania has successfully transitioned from a nongovernmental organization to a faith-based organization and to have obtained charitable status. These milestones will help Compassion International Tanzania continue our mission and live out our faith, while the new charitable status will provide tax savings that allow us to better serve children living in poverty.
tpl_looking_forward: In the coming year, we aim to equip and empower local church partners by implementing targeted initiatives that address their most pressing needs. This will also help provide clearer insight to guide decisions and the care they provide to children.

tpl_prayer: Pray for consistent peace in northeastern Uganda, especially in the Karamoja region, so children and youths can safely participate in programs without disruption. Ongoing conflict in the area — including cattle raiding and intercommunity violence — continues to affect families, displace communities and disrupt daily life.
tpl_praise: We thank God for peaceful national elections. While we are not involved in politics, stability and peace are essential for serving children and supporting effective programs.
tpl_looking_forward: We look forward to strengthening our efforts to reach children in remote and hard to reach areas where the need is greatest. In these communities, many children face serious health challenges that affect their ability to survive and thrive. As we step into these areas, we are excited to help change the story of these communities through improved health support and care for children.
